name: Arachnophobia
label: Quest
description: A Horde bounty sends you west of Windshear Crag after Besseleth, the ancient spider haunting southern Stonetalon Mountains. Claim her fang for Maggran…

clips.title: The story
paras: A Horde bounty sends you west of Windshear Crag after Besseleth, the ancient spider haunting southern Stonetalon Mountains. Claim her fang for Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat, and the mountain roads may grow safer for travelers after dark.

A weathered wanted poster warns travelers on the main road south of Windshear Crag of dangers to the west. Sishir Canyon and Webwinder Path are overrun by spiders. At the heart of the threat is Besseleth, an unusually large orange spider who commands her brood. After sunset, she ambushes anyone who strays from the path.

Maggran Earthbinder, a tauren at Sun Rock Retreat, has posted the bounty on Besseleth. He nearly died in an earlier encounter, when her massive two-foot fang struck him. Maggran fought her off and limped to safety, but the wound still reminds him of the danger in the canyon shadows. He hopes an adventurer will bring him Besseleth's Fang and secure the passes, so trade and travel to Sun Rock Retreat can continue without fear.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Warning: Proceed into Sishir Canyon west of here at your own risk.
Besseleth and her eight-legged children of the forest have claimed this canyon as their webbed lair.

Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat has placed a bounty on Besseleth. Slay her and bring proof of your killing to Maggran; there you will receive your reward for disposing this eight-legged menace.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good hunting, friend! Besseleth is an old predator in these parts... I will miss her not. Take this reward as a token for being the forest champion.
Perhaps now many more will travel to Sun Rock Retreat without fearing what lurks in the dark.
